variables.meaning: the standard reduction potential of a half-reaction, such as the reduction of dichromate, permanganate or titanium dioxide in acid solution
the crystal field splitting of an octahedral complex, the energy difference between its eg and t2g orbitals
the pairing energy, the energy needed to place two electrons of opposite spin in one orbital
the crystal field splitting of a tetrahedral complex, the energy difference between its t2 and e orbitals
the wavelength of the light a complex absorbs, such as 499 nm at the absorption maximum of [Ti(H₂O)₆]³⁺
the frequency of the light absorbed at the maximum
the energy of one photon of the absorbed light, equal to the crystal field splitting at the absorption maximum
the speed of light in a vacuum, the product of the wavelength and the frequency
